name: 玩具工作台
prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Generate ONE production-quality visual direction sheet for Fake Bomb It, a Chinese mobile LANDSCAPE bomber game. This is concept art, not gameplay. Current date 2026-10-20. Direction name: 玩具工作台; no numbers on image.
Frame 2160x1440, ONE coherent design across a 2-column x 3-row grid of six complete ultra-wide screenshots (each ~3:1 phone landscape). Left column light "浅色", right dark "深色"; rows "菜单", "对局", "设置". No phone bezel, OS/browser chrome or perspective. Six states of ONE concept, not multiple unrelated ideas.
Two attached screenshots are the real game's existing dark/light content. Keep gameplay semantics, four actors, full rectangular 17x15 map and two compact actor rows per side. Upgrade plain UI into friendly rounded tactile arcade styling with crisp readable Chinese, soft offset shadows, restrained mint/ivory/peach light palette and deep midnight teal dark palette. Dark must change FLOOR/WALL/CRATE art too; skin colors independent. Grounded small original mint rabbit and coral robot, no new game characters.
Distinct structure: a compact TOY WORKBENCH. Menu has logo on left, broad illustrated candy/factory theme strip across middle, a short skin-portrait rail on right, start button bottom right. Quiet integrated status shelves around the central full-height arena. Settings is a single wide workbench: slim left category rail, middle control list, right small meaningful safe-area position preview. Flatter and more compact than big ornamental character stages.
MENU: "Fake Bomb It", two illustrated terrain previews labeled "糖果乐园" and "玩具工厂", independently chosen "薄荷兔" and "珊瑚机甲", dominant "开始游戏", settings gear and sun/moon. No currencies, shop, ranks, levels, accounts or invented features.
IN GAME: complete centered top-down 17x15 arena with border/pillars, wafers or toy crates and clear corridors. Two left actor rows "玩家", "AI 1", two right "AI 2", "AI 3", portraits + bomb/capacity/range/speed, no labels on characters. Timer 02:00. Large circular joystick near LEFT safe edge, large "放弹" button near RIGHT safe edge. Five utility icons in one top-right row: pause, fullscreen, settings, sun/moon, layers. No overlap with map or status rows.
SETTINGS: "设置", slim categories "操作" and "声音 / 画面". Segmented "固定摇杆" / "浮动摇杆". Four clear slider rows: "摇杆距左" 12px, "摇杆距底" 8px, "放弹距右" 12px, "放弹距底" 8px. Distance measured from button OUTER edge to safe boundary, not from center. Position preview with whole map and both controls. Light screen fixed selected/all four sliders active; dark screen floating selected/FIRST TWO sliders dimmed disabled with values retained, bomb sliders active. Caption "左侧按下出现，松手隐藏". Small volume/particle controls subordinate. Footer actions "恢复操作默认值" and "完成". Do not add sensitivity, vibration, or button sizing. Closing settings does not auto-resume.
Make all six scenes readable and aligned with consistent component grammar, not a decorative poster. Use actual game objects as subject, generous enough hierarchy, minimal decorative background, no feature inventory. Preserve full uncropped map and touch usability.
previousFailures: Two built-in requests failed with network errors; the third request uses a shorter structure-led prompt with the same confirmed constraints.
